solar_panels.evidence: A blue rectangular gridded patch on the west-facing roof face of the central house looks like a small panel array, though it could be a skylight.
solar_panels.detail: Small array on the left roof slope

signals.notes: The house sits under heavy mature tree canopy and shadow, so most of the roof, yard and driveway are hidden; the driveway appears to run through the trees from the road to the northeast.
